name: Data Insights: Analyze, Engage, and Drive Growth with Powerful User Analytics
author: Shahidul Islam

sections.description:
Data Insights is the ultimate user analytics tool for WordPress plugin and theme developers. This powerful plugin helps you gather actionable, non-sensitive data about your plugin users and competitors. Use the insights to optimize features, understand user behavior, and gain a competitive edge in the market.

With Data Insights, you can identify trends, monitor user engagement, and even collect custom data points to unlock hidden growth opportunities. By leveraging this data, you’ll be equipped to make smarter development decisions and maximize your revenue potential.

Key Features

📊 Comprehensive User Analytics Dashboard

Gain valuable insights into how users interact with your plugin or theme. Analyze usage trends, engagement patterns, and behavioral data to improve your product offerings.

🔍 Competitor Analysis for Plugins & Themes

Understand what your competitors are doing by analyzing data from competing plugins and themes. Make informed decisions to stay ahead in the market.

🛡️ Non-Sensitive Data Collection

We prioritize privacy by collecting only non-sensitive, anonymized data. This ensures compliance with privacy regulations like GDPR while still providing you with actionable insights.

✍️ Custom Data Collection

Need specific insights? Use the custom data collection feature to capture unique data points that are important to your business goals.

📈 Data Reports with Graphs

Access detailed visual reports with powerful graphs to easily analyze trends and patterns in user behavior.

✉️ Email Verification via Reoon Email Verifier

Ensure the accuracy of your email list with built-in Reoon Email Verifier integration. Validate email addresses seamlessly as part of your data insights strategy.

🔗 FluentCRM Integration

Streamline your marketing efforts by integrating Data Insights with FluentCRM. Easily set up custom tags and manage user engagement directly from your WordPress dashboard.

🧩 Code Copy Feature

Simplify your workflow with the code copy tool. Generate and copy custom code snippets in just a click to accelerate development tasks.

📥 Uninstall Feedback System

Collect valuable user feedback during the uninstallation process to understand their experience and reasons for leaving.

⚡ Performance & System Optimizations

Data Insights is built for speed and efficiency, ensuring smooth operation without affecting your site’s performance.

How It Works

  1. Install and Activate: Upload the plugin and activate it from the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Integrate SDK: Add the lightweight SDK to your custom plugin or theme for data tracking.
  3. View Insights: Access the Data Insights dashboard to monitor user behavior, competitor analysis, and custom data.
  4. Optimize & Monetize: Use actionable insights to enhance your product and increase revenue.

Third-Party Services

  1. Gravatar
    Used to display user profile images. Learn more at gravatar.com.

  2. Reoon Email Verifier
    Integrated to validate email addresses for reliable communication. The feature is optional and can be disabled as per preference.
sections.installation:
1. Download and upload the data-collector-insights folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Data Insights Dashboard to configure and start analyzing data.
